title: Database Administration Project - Algorithmic Trading
summary: An Oracle database deployment project for an algorithmic trading system, providing scripts for schema migration, backup, and maintenance of historical stock market data. Its data/synthesize_data.py script uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic stock data from a small demo CSV, fitting and sampling 10,000 synthetic rows.
evidence: data/synthesize_data.py:29-35 fits GaussianCopulaSynthesizer on real_data and samples 10000 synthetic rows
